paite: Mi tengteng aw, hiai ngaikhia unla; khovel a om tengteng aw, bildoh un.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding; Korah Tate La / Hauhsakna Muan Ahaihuaina

paite: Mineu leh milian, mihau leh mizawng in leng.
Ka kam in pilna thu agen ding a; ka lungtang ngaihtuah tuh theihsiamna thu ahi ding hi.
Genteh thu ah ka bil ka doh ding a; ka thugil gen kaihging in ka gentel ding hi.
Ni hoihloute ah, ka khetul bul a thulimlouhna in hon umsuak in leng, bang ding in ka lau dia!
Amau neih-le-lam muang a, amau hauhna tampi suangte'n.
Kuamah in a-unau atan thei kei ding uh, Pathian kiang ah tatna leng apiaksak thei sam kei ding uhi.
Ahinna uh tatna ding in tatna man atam lua a, tangtawn a leng angim louh mai ding ahi.
Adam gige a, muatna amuhlouhna ding in.
Mipilte asi ua, huai bang in, mihai leh mimawlte leng amang tuaktuak ua, aneih-le-lam uh midangte anutsiat zel uhi.
Alungsim ngaihtuahdan uh, a-innte uh tangtawn a om ding bang leh, a-omnate uh suan tengteng tan a om ding bang in ahi; agamte uh amau min mah atamsak uhi.
Himahleh mihing pahtawi in a-om gige kei ua; gamsa mangthangte bang ahi uhi.
Hiai kihaimuante tuah ahi a, atan ua kipakte tawpna. Selah

Belamhon bang in Sheol a ding a seh ahi, sihna amaute avak ding hi, zingsang lam in midiktatte'n atung uah thu anei ding ua; a-omnate ua a-omlouhna ding in, akilawmna uh Sheol hihsiat ding ahi ding hi.
Ka hinna bel Pathian in Sheol thilhihtheihna a kipan atankhe ding a; ama'n ahon kipahpih ding hi. Selah
Mi hihhauh a ahong om a, a-insung thupina ahong thupi huthut in leng, lau ke'n.
Asih hun chiang in bangmah akeng kei ding hi; athupina in zui khe lou ding ahi ngal a.
Adam lai in nuamsa mahleh, adamsung in phat loh mahleh.
Amah suangtute lam ah apai dia, vak amu ngei kei ding uh.
Mihing, pahtawi a om a, theihsiamna nei tuan lou zaw, gamsa mangthang zelte bang phet ahi uhi.
